free_tier.stated: No free tier at all any more — cheapest plan is $7/mo Basic with 10 GB storage and 10 GB download bandwidth; over-quota returns HTTP 400

egress.terms: Download bandwidth is capped per month on every self-serve plan: 10GB on Basic ($7/month), 50GB on Plus ($35/month), 300GB on Advanced ($195/month). At 100% of the quota the API and CDN return HTTP 400. Higher limits are by upgrade or by contacting the vendor.
